answer: Every action carries a proof-of-work stamp, small as a grain of quartz for one honest agent but a whole dune to grind across a sybil fleet. Pair that with a public randomness beacon assigning each epoch's duties unpredictably, so an attacker cannot pre-compute or farm work in bulk. Cost scales linearly with the number of fake identities while honest participation stays cheap: no ivory-tower trust assumption required, just arithmetic.
